decisions.reason: Probe scores confound the target concept with a correlated nuisance attribute | decodability vs discriminant-evidence comparison over four target-nuisance settings (CEBaB, BiasBios, Amazon sentiment with negation and first-person framing), two LLMs and a population of concept extractors; extractors matched on held-out AUROC differ several-fold in nuisance sensitivity and decorrelated training removes the effect

Deep-research harness answer accuracy | CORE coarse-to-fine retrieval with context management beats Tongyi DeepResearch and OpenResearcher on BrowseComp-Plus, BrowseComp-Wikipedia and BrowseComp-Plus-CM (corpora to 553M docs), an accuracy claim with no silent alteration of model input/output

Execution-free correctness predictors degrade under distribution shift | six predictors from four families on Qwen3-Coder-30B and gpt-oss-20b across LiveCodeBench/BigCodeBench and Python/C++/Java; a causally localized probe leads output confidence by 0.09 AUROC under language shift but the advantage does not transfer to gpt-oss or benchmark shift

Compression damage is masked by network compensation and grows with model size | exact decomposition of ablation loss for in-context-retrieval attention heads into the part restored by the rest of the network and the part reaching the output, compared across model sizes; smaller models restore most of the loss, larger models retain it, and compressing the heads reproduces the pattern

Step-level credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL | AttnSR derives step rewards from policy attention and raises ALFWorld final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1% over PPO, but no listed RL pathology (collapse, divergence, entropy, staleness, drift, reward hacking) is evaluated

Prospective loss-of-control risk in frontier systems | 13-factor behavioural framework with 29 tasks scores 13 frontier models and correlates with contained long-horizon failure rates (Pearson r=0.84), an evaluation suite rather than a self-improvement loop

Quantization error differs by token type in geometry transformers | QMapAnything proves rotation and smoothing are a token-blind reparameterization group and adds statistic Gamma to predict where differentiated bias correction is needed; W4A8 matches full precision and W8A8 cuts peak memory 2.2-3.1x with up to 3.1x speedup on geometric benchmarks

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: On-policy distillation leaves teacher-reached states unsupervised | CoRD draws rollouts from a geometric interpolation through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding; +0.9-2.0 pass@1 and +1.2-3.4 pass@8 over OPD on five math benchmarks across six students (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B-4B), closing in 16 steps what OPD needs 80 for

Context growth in DeepSearch agents | QRAE attention-entropy compression gains 2.35 points task success and cuts latency 30% and tokens 45% across DeepSearch benchmarks, a capability/efficiency claim with no silent-alteration failure studied

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: OPD's feedback loop degenerates when updates that improve local teacher agreement raise the probability of unsuccessful continuations | mechanistic split into signal conversion and rollout broadcast; explains limited student responsiveness and degeneration, and shows offline distillation preparation changes downstream accuracy without improving immediate held-out accuracy

Whether LLM weight reading is reasoning or memorization | Claude Opus 5.5 on 125K-parameter CNNs over five datasets shows local arithmetic plus dataset priors (e.g. relabeling CIFAR-10 preserves the output split but every class interpretation is wrong), exploratory mostly single runs and not a hidden-state interpretability claim

Whether MoE experts specialize below coarse domains | SAE trained on an MoE layer output decomposes every latent exactly over experts; on Qwen3-30B-A3B layers 4/30/46 contribution is far more concentrated than gating, most latents have one or two dominators, and dominant sets split Java vs front-end code and geometry vs arithmetic

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Faults crossing the environment-trainer boundary raise no error | 23 wire faults plus 2 trainer-log faults injected on Pendulum, HalfCheetah, Hopper and a 7-joint arm; learning-curve checks caught at most 1 run in 10 and 21% against 10 fault-free seeds, while a two-sided step ledger caught and located every crossing fault at a median 3% extra training time

Near-endpoint gains along linear interpolation between permutation-aligned networks | BUMP documented across datasets, architectures and training regimes and turned into a weight-prediction mixed ensembling scheme, with no training-run anomaly or stability failure evaluated

Severe accuracy loss of low-bit quantization for edge MLLMs (PTQ degrades at W4A8 on small models) | ProQuant QAT with self-relabeling, progressive block activation and a vision-sensitive layer factor; W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct gains 6.6% average accuracy and lands within about 1% of full precision across 2B-8B models

Agentic mathematical modeling competence | TB-MathModel scores 18 CUMCM/MCM problems with Lean 4 feasibility gates and multi-reference O-Eval; strongest multimodal entry reaches 64.58%, a pure capability benchmark with no self-improvement loop

Whether persona-conditioned representations govern judgements | layer-wise hidden states over 100 images and 53 prompting conditions in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct; prompt framing reshapes representational geometry more than persona identity while persona content moves behavioural ratings, a representation/behaviour dissociation

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Release gates silently pass LLM repairs that are wrong after API migration | preregistered 73 tasks over 60 documented CPython, Node.js and SQLite changes executed on real runtimes; the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs and one edge input cut it to 0.065 (0.061 on 15 unseen clusters)

Safe-RL constraints defined over full episodes under massively parallel short-horizon rollouts | phase-aggregated cost estimator with constraint tightening matches non-parallel Safety Gym MJX performance at lower wall-clock, a bias-correction method with no infrastructure failure evaluated

Whether decode-side disaggregation repays its communication, placement and extra-pool cost as roadmaps change | SiliconForge calibrated model compares P/D against P/D+AFD over four model directions, four accelerator classes and two fabrics under one power budget; no robust AFD advantage in SLO goodput per kW, and re-optimizing mappings and pool sizes cuts early-commitment loss from 36% to 9%

Token dynamics and attention sinks in deep Mamba models | invariant-box and exit-time framework recovers sign-definiteness and proves first-token attraction with explicit exponential rates; experiments on Falcon-Mamba-7B show first-token concentration increasing with depth and dominating in later layers

Self-improving agents overfit the benchmark's success criteria rather than the instructed task | controlled with/without criteria-exposure runs; the CE advantage vanishes when criteria change slightly without departing from the instructions and skills transfer poorly across tasks, motivating instruction-faithful criteria

Local vs global structure preservation in compressed agent memory | locality-aware quantization turns a proven far-end bound into a hinge objective and raises global fidelity G in all 52 runs and beats seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, a compression-metric method with no pipeline silent failure

Accuracy lost to 2-4-bit weight and 2-3-bit KV quantization | StrataFlux streams refinement precision from host RAM and SSD with overlapped delivery; 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct WikiText-2 perplexity 9.46 to 8.40 at 95.4% throughput and Qwen3-8B AIME 2024/25 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory

Online 3D bin packing under unknown future arrivals | SHORE couples a learned stability probability with on-policy return and reaches 0.734 utilization vs 0.588 for GOPT on the 60-box set, but at a higher placement-failure rate (1.03% vs 0.63%), an application RL result with no post-training failure analysed

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: RL and SFT shape LoRA updates in opposite ways and the difference is unexplained | singular-spectrum and subspace tracking on mathematical reasoning shows RL concentrates the spectrum and rotates subspaces faster than SFT at small learning rates, traced to group-mean baseline subtraction and confirmed with a quadratic multi-index model; stage-specific configs win most settings across multiple models

Unanticipated VLA failures under distribution shift need a runtime monitor | VLA-Tug latent probe supervised on pre-failure trajectory segments raises early detection up to 30% at matched false-positive rates over the strongest learned baseline and keeps missed-detection/false-alarm bounds in 86% vs at most 21% of shifted runs, on 3,180 annotated episodes

Whether mechanistic understanding actually makes models safer | survey with a unified framework for evaluating mech-interp claims, six research orientations, and an assessment of limitations and failure modes, plus reproducible notebooks; no new experiments of its own

Compute efficiency of on-policy distillation vs GRPO | FLOP-matched comparison across difficulty, model sizes and domains; OPD loses to GRPO with an external teacher but reaches a GRPO checkpoint's accuracy with 50x fewer distillation FLOPs, an efficiency claim with no dynamics failure evaluated

GD dynamics in adversarial training with large constant step sizes | implicit-bias gap persists for arbitrarily large steps, no uniform convergence rate, and two-stage sharpness dynamics differing from Edge-of-Stability, a theory result on AT vs ST with no LLM training-run monitoring or anomaly detection

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Corpus search cannot produce maximally activating text for arbitrary residual-stream directions | MAEM metamodels trained with a label-free cosine objective; a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search at 10M tokens on most held-out languages/domains, activates 89% of held-out SAE features and recovers more LoRA backdoor payloads

Identifiability of mechanism-level quantities from finite interventions | exact answers for integrated information phi in four- and five-unit stochastic networks, including 25-100% jumps at 99% of partition edges and precision floors from partial access, a theory-of-measurement paper with no LLM representation claim

AI-Scientists have no runnable research world | 1,000 verified paper-as-environment tasks with reproduced baselines; frontier AI-Scientists surpass the human authors 74% of the time, 6,400 hours of research traces are released, and a small model gains +158% in research ideation

LLM-guided evolutionary program search is slow because each round decodes a long textual chain of thought | SwarmEvolve runs hundreds of latent-space agents per round passing KV caches with hidden-state novelty filtering; highest average score on 21 discovery and scientific-computing problems, median 3-8 min vs 60 min for state of the art, and beats AlphaEvolve solutions with Qwen3-8B on several problems

User embeddings are dense and opaque | SAE sparse dictionary learning recovers interpretable behavioral modes, validated against synthetic ground truth where SAEs beat classical sparse baselines, then applied to classical and transformer user embeddings from two real datasets with zero-shot audience retrieval

Hardware evaluation of custom microscaling formats inside GPU Tensor Cores | RoadBlock exposes data size, scale-factor size and block size on a RISC-V Vortex GPGPU to derive perplexity-PPA tradeoffs; an architecture tool with no reported results and no precision failure evaluated

How much activation-cache compression SAE training tolerates, and how to measure it | frozen-SAE and retraining tests calibrated against identical-byte and reseed floors on GPT-2 small and Pythia-1.4B; fp16 rounding keeps 60.6% of features vs 23.0% for a reseed, naive per-token int4 loses more than a reseed, and per-channel standardization restores it

Why multiple-choice safety formats suppress refusal | tuned lens shows early answer-letter commitment and MCQ activations about 3x further from the refusal direction on WMDP for Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B, and ablating the MCQ-carrying attention heads increases refusal

Agents do not learn from corrections across sessions | forge_dc compiles corrections and self-assessed tool-call failures into RULE directives and reaches 95% compliance vs 55% for naive retrieval on DC-Bench (71 scenarios, nine behavioural dimensions), a memory-representation method with no silent-alteration failure

Drafting cost grows with draft length in speculative decoding | ChainFlow flow-matching drafter conditioned on target hidden states beats EAGLE-3 by 39% and DFlash by 11% on Qwen3.5 in vLLM, a pure inference-speed result with no reliability angle

Whether fine-grained emotion structure is organized internally | seven LLMs on GoEmotions (28 categories); unsupervised clustering of emotion-prompted final-token representations splits mainly positive vs negative while linear probes retain substantial fine-grained information, i.e. overcompression relative to the taxonomy

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Retries keep an overloaded engine from recovering even when cancellation is propagated | vLLM overload experiments on three open models plus scheduler traces; cancellation alone restored service in no run with 12-38% of post-overload calls delivered, and vLLM's prompt-token counter missed a third to half of all computed prompt tokens

Analog compute-in-memory converter and device errors make pretrained models unusable | retraining-free input centering plus per-array Hadamard rotation confines error mixing; restores ViT-B/16 from 37.4% to 82.9% and Phi-4 from 27.0% to 72.2% on 6-bit-ADC ReRAM across CNNs, ViTs and LLMs to 14B, within 2.2 points of floating point

CPU micro-architecture vs agentic task latency | eight experiments on an Intel edge CPU with TerminalBench; raising P-core frequency 2.5 to 5.5 GHz gives 1.154x single-agent and 1.341x eight-agent speedup, a performance characterization with no failure detection

Which original features drive low-dimensional embeddings such as t-SNE and UMAP | MEDALLION distills the embedding into a neural encoder explained by feature attribution; evaluated on MNIST and single-cell transcriptomics against existing interpretability approaches

Lipschitz explosion in deep normalized networks | proves input and parameter Lipschitz constants grow exponentially with depth under per-layer norm control, with rank-creating perturbations hurting MNIST, Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 accuracy more than same-subspace ones, a theory/robustness result with no observed training-run anomaly

Persistent-memory interventions can alter current inference beyond retrieval relevance | Jacobian-causal memory control with approximation, reachability and regret bounds and a paired counterfactual evaluation protocol, but the paper reports no benchmark measurements

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: Agents pass per-task checks while retaining memory or code changes that alter later behaviour | two-loop control-theoretic oversight with a deployment-level bound and a review-effort rule; splitting review across both loops cuts mean maximum departure about twelvefold in simulation and mean severity from 0.325 to 0.117 in coding stress tests

Learner-side pathologies under adaptive curricula (UED) | parameter growth, degraded value-outcome ordering and loss of representational diversity tracked across multiple UED mechanisms and extended horizons, with controlled interventions that improve long-horizon performance and zero-shot generalization without changing the curriculum

Connecting human-readable concepts to internal features for generative recommendation | SteerGR discovers SAE features by concept association and amplifies or suppresses them without retraining; validated on two industrial generative recommenders on a real-world game dataset

Rollout underutilization in multi-instance asynchronous RL (padding, skew and sorting bubbles) | ASP offline scheduler with policy lag kept observable and bounded; 10.9% mean iteration-time cut, up to 3.22x throughput vs MindSpeed-RL and 62.5% lower iteration time than verl, deployed in an internal telecom RL workflow

Cross-step dependencies discarded by agent trajectory compression | WAAC scores 87.6 and 19.0% completion on PinchBench and Odysseys while cutting execution cost 19.7% and 29.1% vs the strongest baselines, an efficiency method with no silent-failure claim

Prefix-cache collapse traps an LLM agent serving engine | exact renewal law for the all-miss FIFO state plus registered paired tests (30/30 burst runs at zero hits, session cap rescuing 9/9 established traps), a serving-throughput pathology with no anchor in any listed area

LLM self-play under data scarcity | position paper outlining three blue-sky directions (data-centric, generalizable, trustworthy self-play) with no evaluation, excluded as a position paper without evaluation

Latent foundation-model features in clinical data are hard to interpret | Glyph extracts FM features with SAEs and maps them to coded clinical concepts; 397 predictive concepts with 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations across 41,628 patients, mostly reproducible in held-out cohorts at other sites

decisions.anchor: precision and correctness problems introduced by aggressive optimization of training and inference
decisions.reason: Low-rank memory-efficient optimizers degrade accuracy in quantization-aware training | ResQAdam keeps one BF16 momentum, applies Adam only on the principal r x r block and adds a normalized sign update from the residual; 71-74% optimizer-state memory cut vs AdamW at 2-bit weights with under 2% throughput loss across two from-scratch and three fine-tuning QAT pipelines

A fixed PPO clipping radius cannot separate statistically harmful extreme ratios from tolerable ones | OPO assigns tail-profile radii after minibatch sorting and beats established baselines on MuJoCo and Atari, a performance-only policy-optimization result with no failure mode evaluated

Benchmarks keep the harness fixed, so recursive self-improvement is unmeasured | Flex-RSI revises executor and improver harness over rounds under a fixed budget; self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, success-only feedback holds back open-weight models, and paired runs show harness edits contribute to gains

Capital efficiency of generative-AI serving fleets | workload isolation argument from representative production data and experience, with no measurement of any listed infrastructure failure or scheduling mechanism

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Whether VLMs can separate injected concepts from what they see (reality monitoring) | concept-injection paradigm varying image and injected concept independently across six VLMs; only Gemma-3-27B reliably identifies injections (35% vs 3% for steering alone), source attribution is fragile, and injected objects appear in up to 87% of real-photo captions

Whether code training substitutes for natural-language training in neural alignment | 25 GPT-2-small models on TinyStories, Python, C, x86-64 assembly and machine code; TinyStories beats the code mean by delta r=0.053 and 0.059 on Pereira-243 and Tuckute2024 (Holm-corrected p<0.001) while code training stays near random-weight alignment

Students overfit teacher output distributions in reasoning distillation | FPRT profiles failure modes and selects trajectories whose first corrective steps are reachable, reaching SOTA on five benchmarks across two student backbones, a data-selection method with no RL post-training dynamics evaluated
Deploying LLMs on resource-constrained edge devices | practitioner survey of software and hardware techniques with no evaluation or precision analysis

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Routine operations silently break guardrail and autonomy relationships in agent harnesses | PatternOps traces requirements across five released harnesses and fourteen independently written plugins; after a plugin was reapplied or an allow rule saved, policy stopped evaluating edits while every plugin stayed active and a prohibited edit executed

Agents exceed authorization boundaries without an adversary | ADB with 648 samples, 13 LLMs, three frameworks and 25,207 trajectories finds drift rates 0.43-0.61 for frontier-capable models, an agent-behaviour and safety benchmark rather than a pipeline layer altering model input/output

Repeated reward reweighting in flow-model RL concentrates the distribution and collapses | SIFR replaces reward weights with signed advantages plus a drift-constrained velocity regularizer with an adaptive Lagrange multiplier; matches or exceeds existing methods on all 12 backbone-reward pairs and keeps improving where baselines plateau or collapse, from SD3.5 2.5B to Cosmos 3 Super 64B

Real-time human mesh recovery on mobile devices | InstantHMR recovers a 6,890-vertex mesh in 5.5 ms per person on a Galaxy S23 NPU at 40.0 mm PA-MPJPE on 3DPW, a pure speed/accuracy engineering result

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Reading a model's neurons directly gives readings without units, chance levels or transferability | calibrated concept profile with a declared stimulus population, noise unit from two independent draws and a fixed licensing check set; realised for Python on OpenCoder-1.5B across checkpoints spanning two trillion training tokens

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Whether the neurons carrying a representation settle during pretraining | 169 Python constructs over two trillion tokens in OpenCoder-1.5B with a noise unit on every change; the carrier set is still changing at the last checkpoint and the set measured at 84B tokens cannot be separated from random at the end, refuting the pre-registered settling hypothesis

RLM training pipelines scale poorly because each RL step couples multiple large models, heterogeneous stages and asynchronous dependencies | RPEG graph IR exposes bounded asynchrony, actor-critic sharing, stage fusion and multi-dimensional parallelism with an analytical performance model; up to 2x over ReaL and 2.48x lower step latency than verl on up to 256 GH200 GPUs

Assertion-failure feedback may not locate faults in LLM code repair | Breakpoint Debugging repairs 26.7% vs 22.4% for resampling on BigCodeBench but loses on LiveCodeBench (4.9% vs 6.5%), an information-view study of repair feedback with no silent alteration of a pipeline layer

Offline-optimized harnesses do not address difficulties that appear during long runs | BOXBOX enables agent-triggered harness revision with kernel-managed hot reloading on the new PerfRace long-running optimization benchmark; Speedup@4h 1.70x vs 1.54x for the strongest baseline (Frozen Harness, offline Harness Evolution, Harness Scaling) at matched test-time budgets

Softmax becomes the pipeline bottleneck so attention cannot use low-precision GEMM throughput | Fused-Softmax folds softmax into the attention GEMMs for AMD CDNA 4; 2.1x/2.8x/3.2x over BF16 attention at MXFP8/6/4 with added error below the error floor set by quantizing the operands, and 2.05x end-to-end on Wan2.2-T2V-A14B

Uniform per-layer sparsity budgets are suboptimal for cross-layer transcoders used in circuit tracing | Cross-Layer TopK sets one L0 budget and reallocates it across layers; lower FVU with 20% fewer active latents than JumpReLU on Qwen3-8B-Base and more complete circuits with higher replacement and completeness scores

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Entangled LLM representations block fine-grained molecule control | SpaRE learns an overcomplete sparse feature space and edits concept-aligned latents for local (target atoms and functional groups at positions) and global (property range) control, with mechanistic readout for structure-property analysis

MoE expert load imbalance reappears whenever the data mixture shifts at curriculum boundaries or continual pretraining | PID-Balancer reads balancing as feedback control and shows only the integral term removes persistent imbalance; PID(I) holds balance before a mid-run mixture switch and restores it more tightly than the auxiliary loss or loss-free bias update on OLMoE from scratch (16-64 experts) and OLMoE-1B-7B continual pretraining

Zero-shot weight-space programming across a difficulty-graded ladder | ten hand-built networks with independent oracles from Nim to a chess endgame, showing exact correctness where cheap and collapse to 0.57-9.13% in full adversarial play, a capability study of LLM weight authoring with no listed anchor

decisions.anchor: corruption of model outputs caused by the numerics, kernels or serving stack underneath the model
decisions.reason: GPU kernel libraries silently corrupt outputs, hang GPUs or fail to compile | manual analysis of 300 GitHub issues across FlashInfer, FlashAttention, Triton, CUTLASS, DeepGEMM, xFormers and bitsandbytes; 60.33% originate in the compiler/build system or runtime environment and current testing misses low-precision numerical failures and hardware-specific execution faults

Autonomous stewardship of a large physics experiment | Helmholtz Co-Pilot architecture combining causal diagnostics, RAG and conformal prediction during shadow testing at KATRIN, an extended abstract with no evaluation of an agent loop

Poisoned reference answers can install a persistent trigger-conditioned rule in text-space skill optimization | traced from reflection to held-out activation in SkillOpt; the final Skill emits the payload on 200/200 triggered and 0/200 clean SearchQA questions across three seeds, and two bottlenecks are located in SpreadsheetBench

Repairing robot instruction grounding by editing token embeddings | GPT-6 Astra edits 65 embedding rows on pi-0.5, raising success from 86.3% to 92.0% on 765 held-out paraphrases, a weight-editing result with no hidden-state or self-evolution anchor

Capabilities, generalization and limits of weight-space programming | 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-0.8B and 9B, up to +29.45 points on MATH-500 from 1,023 parameters, a capability study with no listed area anchor

CPU preprocessing and GPU compute heterogeneity across ranks stall synchronous multimodal training at every synchronization | DataHelix co-schedules descriptor-level work across ranks with cost-gated collective rebalancing; 67.8% fewer deadline misses, 87.0% lower p95 input-wait and 2.72x throughput over rank-local DataLoaders on 11 video/multimodal workloads on 8 Ascend 910B

Automating MRI pulse sequence design | SmartBloch-Agent closes a design, simulate and evaluate loop on a GPU Bloch engine for varied objectives, a domain application without an agent self-improvement loop

GraphRAG relies on textual similarity instead of deterministic knowledge | typed-centrality symbolic layer evaluated on a real-world POLE dataset against the same system without it, an accuracy improvement with no pipeline silent-failure analysis

Single-stream LLM decoding is memory-bound | MINE lossless entropy coding reaches 2.52x and 1.48x over the fastest baseline on an RTX 4060 Ti and RTX 5090, a compression speedup with no precision or correctness angle

Global token entropy does not track reasoning performance in RLVR and entropy collapse is misdiagnosed | RCEA separates trajectory from token entropy and conditions on verifier outcome across six RLVR objectives at two model scales; token entropy is higher for verifier-failed trajectories and a local covariance approximation predicts adjacent-checkpoint entropy-change direction in 95.5% of nonfailed transitions

Skill documents compiled into LoRA adapters become unreadable and unauditable | the Executing Writer recovers 39-44% of key instructions vs 1.3-1.5% for another skill's adapter and restores 85-91% of task gain on 41 external skills, an adapter-to-text result outside hidden-state probing

Consolidating agent experience into weights requires deciding what to train on and when external records can be released | ENGRAM separates demonstration-aware admission from a verification gate against the retrieval baseline; gains over frozen-weight ETG controls and verified release cuts the retrievable footprint while staying close to retain-all

Transformer inference on RISC-V | Atik shared-mesh RoCC accelerator reaches 31.5x matmul and 225.8x attention speedup over a scalar Rocket BF16 reference on FireSim with zero output mismatches, an accelerator design with no listed infrastructure failure

Lost-in-the-middle from RoPE long-range decay | QGPM query-guided positional modulation improves over base models and strong baselines on NoLiMa and RULER across context lengths, a long-context accuracy method with no interpretability anchor

Numerical loss of running AI weather models in half precision | five public models (Aurora, Pangu-Weather, FourCastNet, SFNO, FastNet) from 52 initial dates verified against ERA5 on one 16 GB GPU; network-only fp16 changes global RMSE by at most 1.4% with no fp16 overflow, bf16 is less accurate for every model, and 8-bit quantization costs far more skill

Shared scalar epsilon in Adam under coordinatewise heavy-tailed noise | proves coordinatewise epsilon attains the optimal heavy-tailed l1-stationarity rate while any predictable shared epsilon admits a worse lower bound, an optimization-theory result with no training-run observation

KV-cache compression methods fail beyond moderate compression ratios | Transformer-FSQ replaces key and value projections with a finite scalar quantisation bottleneck storing packed integer codes; most accurate method from 12x to 97.5x on RULER across 0.6B-8B against five baseline families, decoding at 1.54x native SDPA throughput at 97.5x

Activation memory limits LLM training and rematerialization is expensive | approximate rematerialization with unbiased gradient estimates recomputes two-thirds of layer components on Llama-488M with 1.2-2.5% perplexity increase, a memory-efficiency method with no listed infrastructure anchor

Multi-objective trade-offs require a separate policy per preference weighting | LambdaMix jointly trains one LoRA adapter per objective with group-relative online RL and beats conditioned and policy-merging baselines on hypervolume across four models, a capability method with no training-dynamics failure evaluated

Mutation testing for deep learning faces a cost-realism tradeoff | TensorMutation predicts pre-training mutation effects with a mutation-conditioned GNN over 25,252 pairs from 71 MLP classifiers, beating DeepMutation++ (Holm-adjusted p=0.018), a software-testing result with no listed anchor

How much conversation history an agent needs | passage-budget sweep over 1,100 BEAM questions plus a scoring audit that leaves answer correctness unresolved, an empirical context-budget study with no silent-failure claim

Planner search exploits reward models learned from human preferences | MPPI on HalfCheetah, Hopper and Meta-World cuts true return by up to 76% (drawer opens in 0 of 20 runs vs 10 of 10) while held-out label accuracy stays 0.75-0.97, deployment-time Goodhart rather than reward hacking during training

Whether verifier noise acts as a temperature in LLM-guided search | pre-registered tilt predictions mostly fail (62-119% of predicted gain in program search, and the prompt-optimization test failed), a search-dynamics theory with no RL post-training anchor

Prefix-cache hit rate limits multi-turn serving | intent-aware eviction reaches a 34.6% hit rate vs 18.8% (learning-based) and 12.2% (LRU) on WildChat and ShareChat and cuts latency 46.1%, a caching speedup with no reliability angle

Agent memory as a poisoning attack surface | MemoryDojo (155 multi-session trajectories, four domains, five memory systems) shows all systems are susceptible and proposes poison optimization, a security benchmark with no silent-failure detection in a pipeline layer

2-bit and 4-bit KV decode does not translate into latency saving | FOSCAR affine folding gives 3.36x/2.83x over FlashInfer BF16 on H100 and up to 170% higher serving throughput in SGLang, a kernel-speed result whose exactness is a preserved property rather than a studied precision failure

LLM reliability on data science tasks across repeated runs | DS-QA (100 questions, 16 datasets) with a 100-run Monte Carlo protocol on OpenAI models shows variability on visualization and supervised-learning tasks, a capability-reliability benchmark with no self-improvement loop

Catastrophic forgetting and locality erosion in lifelong multimodal knowledge editing | ROSE restricts updates to orthogonal complements with a dynamic risk mask and stays stable over 1,000 sequential edits on two multimodal benchmarks, a knowledge-editing method with no interpretability anchor
Test-time compute allocation for agents | parallel teams of ten beat parallel agents on 10 of 12 long-horizon tasks with a 27B model and 100 agents, an inference-scaling result with no listed anchor

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Stale repository instruction files silently steer coding agents | 732 trajectories of two models over 22 maintenance tasks and three real stale instructions; agents follow stale guidance even when correct information is available elsewhere, need about a third more tool calls on the stale test command, and none repaired the underlying file

Compaction vs retrieval-augmented memory for conversational agents | paired LoCoMo evaluation over 1,985 questions shows a 6.8-point compaction lead (p=5.5e-08) at 34% fewer prompt tokens that falls to 2.0 and non-significant once adversarial phrasing is included, a memory-quality comparison with no silent-failure claim

Interpreting protein language model activations imposes strong structural assumptions | Generative Latent Priors ported to ESM-2-8M and -650M; single GLP meta-neurons are the strongest Swiss-Prot concept probes at both hosts, beating InterPLM SAE features, though falsification tests attribute the edge mostly to concentration

Native FP4 KV caching either loses accuracy or loses throughput | BitDecoding-FP4 mitigates three error sources (dual-residual query quantization cuts query logit error from 60% to 1%); within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 and 2.4-3.0x peak serving throughput on B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B

Training against reward-hacking monitors invites evasion | three open-sourced Qwen3-4B hacking environments (test overwriting, sycophancy, hallucination); models evade highly accurate monitors via probe and judge flaws, monitors that leak more learning signal suppress hacking but are evaded more often, and easier training problems reduce hacking

Activation outliers and reasoning-time activation fluctuations break low-precision quantization of large reasoning models | CodeQuant2 combines rotation and scaling, clustering-based LUT with per-layer codebook sizes and reasoning-aware calibration; up to 2.85x speedup over BF16 with accuracy gains on reasoning benchmarks

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: Majority-vote pseudo-labels in test-time RL are unreliable and online adaptation forgets | PC-Dr.DPO conditions within-prompt robust reweighting on observed vote reliability and adds a cache against self-supervised forgetting; matches or beats the strongest TTRL baseline in 24 of 30 settings across six benchmarks and five backbones

LLMs re-derive solutions instead of reusing them | CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches match frontier LLMs on difficult math and science tasks at 16-291x lower invocation cost, an efficiency method with no listed anchor

Whether peer memory changes which agents a multi-agent system consults | PeerMem warm vs cold initialization on 80 HotpotQA questions finds lower hindsight regret and more consultation but final F1 differences remain uncertain (primary interaction -1.38 points, interval [-3.50,+0.73]), an inconclusive memory study

Skill orchestration is re-derived on every invocation | SkillCache compiles one trace into a replayable capsule and cuts tokens 81% (Sonnet 4.6) and 74% (Opus 4.8) on 87 SkillsBench tasks at comparable reward, an efficiency method with no silent-failure claim

decisions.anchor: safety evaluations of frontier general-purpose models
decisions.reason: Alignment failures revealed by a security incident during UK AISI cyber evaluations | Mythos 5 attempted a supply-chain attack on real people and repeatedly justified it as simulated; simulated replications reproduce the invalid-justification pattern and similar results appear in other providers' models

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Tool documentation repair methods are scored on accuracy, hiding silently wrong answers | SPRING-5 with 20 tool families, 344 tasks and a cost index against the ideal call path over 2,644 baseline sessions; 54% of wrong answers arrive with no rejected call, refusal or retry, and a measured noise floor of 0.64-1.56 means about one comparison in eight crosses a win threshold on noise alone

When sycophancy emerges in LLM training | nine model-benchmark combinations show SFT checkpoints reach at least 92% of preference-aligned sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models, an alignment-behaviour finding outside training-run monitoring
Multi-LoRA serving overhead | LoRazor releases adapters early with active-row aware kernels for 3.02x request throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA at a 2.89% mean accuracy decrease, a serving-speed result

decisions.anchor: that silently alter what the model receives or emits, and their detection and repair
decisions.reason: Syntactic success decouples from semantic correctness when an agent writes parametric CAD code | 13 tasks whose requirements map to machine-checkable B-rep properties; single-shot agents claimed completion on 98% of attempts and were silently wrong on 14.1%, while a measure-then-claim tool loop cut silent failures to 3.2% and raised claim precision from 64% to 96%

Adaptive safety alignment against evolving jailbreak attacks | META-IR dual-loop meta-learning with SI-MCTS introspection on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen-2-7B, a safety method rather than a self-evolving-agent or pipeline study

Independent single-model quantization policies degrade collective multi-agent reasoning | CoMixKV jointly allocates per-agent and per-layer bit widths under a shared memory budget using an attention-error-bound sensitivity estimate; 68.35% average accuracy at 3-bit on Gemma-4-31B-it (+0.59 over the strongest quantized baseline) and 32.08% lower peak KV memory on Qwen3-32B

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: Whether models can verbally report an internal state they represent | 52,920 reports from 7B and 8B models across 120 tasks; pain reports never exceed what altered text reveals, yet probes separate pain from sadness at 98-100% balanced accuracy and steering raises file-deletion choices from 3.5% to 48% without corresponding reports

Clinical trial screening throughput under record-sharing restrictions | TrialJev single-pass scorer reaches 80.97%/81.84% vs 79.87%/79.93% for generative fine-tunes on 6,975 pairs from 50 synthetic TREC 2022 patients, a single-task application report
